stem: ![](asset:P000407-stem-1)A mass m rotating freely in a horizontal circle of radius 1 m on a frictionless smooth table supports a stationary mass 2 m, attached to the other end of the string passing through smooth hole O in table, hanging vertically. Find the angular velocity of rotation.

assets.alt: A mass m moving in a circle on a smooth horizontal table, tied by a string through a hole O at the centre to a mass 2m hanging below.
